scenes.name: ONE SENSOR FIRES
lines: One of three quantum sensors fires. The job is to tell which one fired, from the state it leaves behind.
三个量子传感器中有一个触发。我们要根据它留下的量子态，判断触发的是哪一个。
Suppose two different preparations tie. Must averaging their weights make the best guess more accurate?
假如两种不同的准备方法打成平手，把它们的权重平均，最好的猜测就一定更准吗？

scenes.name: COUNT THE BITS
lines: Give equal weight to the three words with one bit set. Or give equal weight to their complements, the three words with two bits set.
可以给只有一位为一的三个串同样的权重，也可以给它们的三个互补串同样的权重。后者各有两位为一。
Look at the first two positions. In each list there is one match and two mismatches. The two mismatches come in opposite orders.
只看前两位。每张清单里，有一个串的前两位相同，另外两个不同，而且这两种不同的排列恰好相反。
The opposite phase contributions pair up. The same count holds for each pair of positions, so the lists give the same table of overlaps.
相反的相位贡献成对出现。换任何一对位置，计数都一样，所以两张清单给出同一张重叠表。

scenes.name: A CONSTANT TABLE
lines: Now mix the weights in any proportion. The overlap table is the same weighted average of two identical tables, so it never changes.
现在按任何比例混合权重。重叠表就是两张相同的表按同样的比例取平均，因此完全不变。
Identical tables let us transfer every measurement statistic. At the angle pi over four, the best error stays positive and exactly the same all the way across.
相同的表让我们保持所有测量统计。当角度为 π 除以 4 时，从一个端点到另一个端点，最小错误率始终为正，且完全相同。

scenes.name: WHAT AVERAGING GUARANTEES
lines: Averaging still cannot exceed the weighted average of the two optimal errors. But this example explains why a strict improvement cannot be promised.
平均后的错误率仍不会超过两个最小错误率的加权平均。但这个例子解释了，为什么不能保证严格改进。
